visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A fair-skinned man with dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt, stands in a studio setting with a solid grey background. He holds six small, rectangular eyeshadow palettes in a fan shape towards the camera, smiling warmly. Yellow subtitles and white brand logos appear at the bottom center and top right of the frame. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of several eyeshadow palettes lined up vertically, showing neutral earth-toned pans. A white text overlay 'ABOUT TONE RETURN TO BASIC' appears prominently in the center. (3) The man holds a specific transparent-cased palette, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting his clear skin and the product's texture. (4) In a series of close-ups, the man demonstrates each palette individually. A brush is used to pick up powder and apply it to his eyelids and brow bone. Text overlays indicate the color number and name, such as '01 CLASSIC'. (5) The demonstration continues through '02 SOFT' and '03 RADIANT', showing variations of beige, brown, and warm tan shades. The camera shifts to side views to display the blended makeup effect on his face. (6) '04 SERENE' is shown with rose and mauve tones being applied. The man looks directly into the camera or slightly to the side to show the depth of the eyeshadow application. (7) '05 CAPPUCCINO' and '06 DAWN' are presented, featuring deeper browns and cool-toned greys. The man uses his fingers to blend some colors, emphasizing the product's ease of use. (8) In the final phase, the man holds all six palettes again, clapping his hands together and making a 'call me' hand gesture, concluding the presentation with a friendly smile.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic greeting from a male voice, accompanied by a bright, mid-tempo electronic pop BGM. The voice is clear and professional, with a friendly rise in intonation. A subtle 'whoosh' SFX signals the start of the product intro. (2) As the speaker introduces the 'About Tone' brand, a digital 'pop' sound effect coincides with text appearing on screen. The BGM maintains a steady, driving beat with synthesized percussion. The speaker's arousal level is high, indicating enthusiasm. (3) During the demonstration of the first three palettes, short 'whoosh' transitions punctuate the cut between each color. The speaker describes the textures and shades with high articulation clarity. The BGM remains consistent in the background, mixed lower than the speech. (4) The demonstration continues for palettes four through six. Each new section is marked by a crisp 'ding' or 'whoosh' effect. The vocal pitch remains expressive and varied, avoiding a monotone delivery while explaining technical makeup details. (5) In the concluding segment, the speaker's tone becomes more persuasive and warm. The BGM volume swells slightly as he finishes his sentence. The track ends with a final 'pop' sound effect and a quick fade-out of the music stems.
